test_title: PYST 61: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: What sum (in ₹) will earn a simple interest of ₹240 in 4 years at 4% per year rate of interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹240

Time (t) = 4 years

Rate of Interest (r) = 4% per year

**Formula used:**

SI = (P times r times t)/(100)

Where, P = Principal

**Calculation:**

240 = (P times 4 times 4)/(100)

⇒ (P times 16)/(100) = 240

⇒ P = (240 times 100)/(16)

⇒ P = ₹1500

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
